reason: A DSH management panel for organizing roleplay character cards, worldbooks, presets, memories, and relationship data, then applying session-specific content to chat context.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 中管理角色卡、世界书、预设、会话记忆和角色关系，并将配置注入角色扮演聊天的管理面板。
summaries.en: A DSH management panel for organizing character cards, worldbooks, presets, session memories, and character relationships and applying them to roleplay chats.

capabilities: Imports character card and worldbook files in PNG or JSON formats
Stores and switches session-specific roleplay presets
Injects preset, worldbook, and memory content into chat context
Generates conversation summaries for memory storage
Extracts and displays character relationship graphs
Renders clickable story options and supports editing AI replies
